# Vendored frontend dependencies

- `echarts.min.js`: Apache ECharts 5.5.0, Apache-2.0
  - Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/echarts/v/5.5.0
- `lucide.min.js`: Lucide 0.468.0, ISC
  - Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide/v/0.468.0
- `three.min.js`: Three.js r160, MIT
  - Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.160.1
- `phaser.min.js`: Phaser 3.90.0, MIT
  - Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/phaser/v/3.90.0

These browser bundles are stored locally so the dashboard remains usable without
loading JavaScript from a public CDN.
